description: This file defines a PHP class named 'Tax' within the OpenCart admin extension for total tax handling. It contains methods for displaying the tax extension settings page ('index') and saving configuration changes ('save'). It manages breadcrumb navigation, page titles, permissions, and the loading of views and models related to the tax total extension.

classes.name: Tax
classes.description: Controller class for managing the settings of the 'Tax' total extension in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the taxonomy settings page, including breadcrumbs, page title, header, and footer components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the configuration settings for the tax total extension, including permission checks and JSON response.
